words.textHint: A yellow writing stick with a sharp point and a rubber tip for fixing mistakes.
A waxy stick of color kids use to draw pictures.
The rubber tool that rubs away marks when you make a mistake.
A tool with two blades you use to cut paper.
Sticky stuff you use to make paper and craft pieces stay together.
You wear this bag over your shoulders to carry books to school.
It has a cover and many pages full of words and pictures to read.
The table at school where you sit and do your schoolwork.
A seat with four legs and a back that you sit on.
A thin white sheet you write and draw on.
A coloring stick with a soft felt tip and a cap that clicks on.
A pad of lined pages where you write your schoolwork.
A straight tool with numbers that helps you measure and draw lines.
Colorful wet stuff you spread with a brush to make pictures.
A dusty white stick used to write on a blackboard.
You carry your sandwich and snacks to school in this container.
It hangs on the wall with hands that point to numbers and tells you the time.
A machine with a screen and a keyboard you use to play games and learn.
A thin writing tool full of ink that does not erase.
A fun little picture with a peel-off backing that stays wherever you press it.
It rings loudly to tell everyone that class is starting or ending.
A drawing that shows roads and places to help you find where to go.
A sticky clear ribbon you pull from a roll to hold things together.
A tool with soft bristles you dip in colors to make pictures.
The pages your teacher asks you to finish after school and bring back the next day.
This person stands at the front of the class and helps kids learn every day.
A kid who goes to class every day to learn new things.
The fun break at school when you get to go outside and play.
The meal you eat in the middle of the school day.
The spot at school where you sit at your desk and learn with your teacher.
A fun spot outside with slides, swings, and monkey bars.
Someone you love to play with and who is always kind to you.
The big room at school where kids run, jump, and play ball games.
This helper checks your body and gives you medicine when you are sick.
This kind helper at the clinic gives you shots and bandages.
A brave helper who sprays water on flames and rescues people.
This helper wears a badge, keeps people safe, and catches bad guys.
This person grows crops and takes care of cows and chickens.
This person makes yummy meals in a kitchen.
This helper looks inside your mouth and keeps your teeth clean and healthy.
A special animal helper who makes sick puppies and kittens feel better.
This person makes fresh bread, cakes, and cookies in a big oven.
This person uses their voice to perform songs on a stage.
This person moves their body to music on a stage.
This person makes beautiful paintings and drawings.
This person sits in the cockpit and flies a big machine through the sky.
This helper brings letters and packages to your house every day.
This person sits at the front of a big yellow vehicle and takes kids to school.
This person feeds the lions and elephants and takes care of wild animals.
A silly circus performer with a red nose and big shoes who makes people laugh.
This performer pulls rabbits out of hats and does amazing tricks.
This worker wears a hard hat and puts up houses with tools.
This person sits by the water with a rod and reel to catch things that swim.
The place kids go every day to learn to read, write, and do math.
A quiet place full of books you can borrow for free.
A green spot with grass and trees where families have picnics and kids play.
A place where you can visit lions, monkeys, and elephants.
A sandy spot by the ocean where you build castles and splash in waves.
A place in the country with a barn, tractors, and animals like cows and pigs.
The big building where doctors and nurses help sick people get better.
A place where you pick things off shelves and pay for them.
A sweet-smelling shop full of fresh bread, cakes, and cookies.
The building where you and your family live.
A giant rocky hill so tall its top can be covered in snow.
A big pool of fresh water surrounded by land, great for swimming and boats.
A place full of tall trees where deer and squirrels live.
A giant stone home with towers where kings and queens live.
A big tent show with clowns, acrobats, and animals.
A big hole filled with clear blue water where you swim in the summer.
A spot near your house where flowers and vegetables grow.
A place where you sit at a table, order food from a menu, and someone brings it to you.
A shop full of dolls, games, and blocks that kids love to visit.
A sweet spot where you pick a cold treat in a cone or a cup.
The building where big red rescue trucks are parked, waiting for an emergency.
A machine with four wheels that your family drives to go places.
A long yellow vehicle that picks up many kids and takes them to school.
It rides on tracks, pulls many long connected sections, and says choo choo.
A big machine with wings that flies people high up in the sky.
It floats on the water and takes people across lakes and rivers.
You pedal this two-wheeled ride and wear a helmet.
A big strong vehicle that carries heavy loads down the road.
A flying machine with spinning blades on top that can go straight up.
It blasts off with flames and smoke and zooms up past the clouds.
A yellow ride you wave down in the city and pay to take you somewhere.
A giant boat that carries people and things across the ocean.
A big red vehicle with ladders and hoses that races to put out flames.
A vehicle with flashing lights and a loud siren that rushes sick people to the hospital.
Officers ride in this vehicle with flashing lights and a loud siren.
You stand on this board with a handle and push with one foot to roll along.
A fast two-wheeled ride with an engine that goes vroom.
A big slow machine with giant back wheels that helps on a farm.
The round part that spins so cars and bikes can roll.
A red octagon at the corner that tells drivers they must halt.
It hangs over the road and turns red, yellow, and green to tell cars what to do.
You click this strap across your lap in the car to stay safe.
The person who is in charge of the whole school.
This helper keeps the school clean by sweeping and mopping the floors.
This helper checks out books and helps you find good stories to read.
The big room at school where everyone eats their midday meal.
The big room at school with a stage where everyone watches shows and assemblies.
A special school day when your class travels somewhere fun, like a museum or a farm.
A paper your school sends home to show your grades.
A contest where students say the letters of tricky words one by one.
The teacher writes on this big shiny surface with markers that wipe off.
A big book that tells you what words mean and how to say them.
A small machine with buttons that helps you do math.
A science tool that makes tiny things look big enough to see.
A round model of the Earth that spins on a stand.
A tool that presses little metal clips through papers to hold them together.
A bright neon marker you use to color over important words so they stand out.
A big ceremony where students wear caps and gowns after finishing school.
A kind school helper you can talk to about your feelings and problems.
This helper holds up a big sign so kids can get to the other side of the street safely.
A person who wears a big white suit and travels far above the Earth.
This person does experiments in a lab to discover new things.
A clever person who designs machines, bridges, and robots.
This person draws the plans for new buildings before they are built.
This worker fixes leaky pipes and sinks in your house.
This worker fixes the wires that bring power to the lights in your house.
This worker uses a hammer, a saw, and nails to build things out of wood.
This worker fixes cars when they are broken.
This person wears a black robe, bangs a gavel, and decides what is fair in court.
This person speaks up for people in court and knows all the rules.
The person who is in charge of a whole town or city.
This person leads a sports team, runs practice, and cheers players on.
This person sits in a tall chair at the pool or beach and keeps swimmers safe.
This helper rides in the emergency vehicle and helps hurt people on the way to the hospital.
A special doctor who does operations to fix people on the inside.
This helper at the drugstore counts pills and gives people their medicine.
This person finds out what is happening in the world and writes news stories.
This person uses a camera to take pictures of people and places.
A kitchen expert in a tall white hat who makes fancy meals at a restaurant.
This person brings your food to the table at a restaurant.
This person at the store takes your money and gives you change.
This person cuts hair in a shop with a striped spinning pole.
This person looks for clues to solve mysteries.
This person pretends to be someone else in movies and plays.
The person who writes the words in your favorite books.
This person dreams up brand new machines and gadgets nobody has made before.
This worker drives a big truck and picks up the trash from outside your house.
This helper serves drinks and keeps passengers safe on an airplane.
A building full of dinosaur bones, paintings, and old treasures to look at.
A place with giant glass tanks where you can watch sharks and fish swim.
A huge place with thousands of seats where people watch big games.
The busy place where people wait to fly away on big winged machines.
A calm spot by the sea where boats come in and tie up.
A tall tower by the sea that shines a bright beam to guide ships at night.
A very tall building in the city with many, many floors.
The place where cars pull in to fill up their tanks with fuel.
A big paved area where drivers leave their cars while they shop.
It stretches over a river so cars and people can get to the other side.
A long hole through a mountain or under the ground that cars drive through.
A big wide road where cars zoom fast between cities.
The striped lines on the street that show where people can safely get to the other side.
The building where people keep their money safe.
The building where you buy stamps and send letters and packages.
The building where a person in a black robe decides what is fair.
A big building where machines and workers make lots of things, like toys or cars.
A building with many beds where travelers pay to sleep on vacation.
A fun place with roller coasters, rides, and carnival games.
A spot in the woods where families sleep in tents and roast marshmallows.
A piece of land with water all around it.
A hot, dry, sandy place where cactuses grow and it almost never rains.
A long metal boat that dives deep under the ocean.
A big boat that carries people and even their cars across the water.
A small narrow boat you paddle with a double-ended oar.
A big fancy boat that rich people ride for fun.
A giant colorful bag floats in the sky with a basket hanging under it for riders.
An underground city ride that zooms through tunnels beneath the streets.
A winged ship that carried astronauts up past the sky and landed like an airplane.
A big truck with a giant blade that pushes the white winter stuff off the roads.
A truck with a big spinning drum that keeps wet concrete ready for building.
A powerful machine with a wide metal blade that pushes dirt and rocks.
A very tall machine with a long arm that lifts heavy things up high at building sites.
The heavy metal hook a boat drops into the water to stay in one place.
A round tool with a needle that always points north.
A little book with your picture inside that lets you visit other countries.
You fill this bag with clothes when you go on a trip.
The round thing a driver turns to make the car go left or right.
A giant balloon-shaped aircraft that floats slowly over stadiums.
